subject: Client impact intake: brief discovery call request (Nimbus Health)
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@nimbushealth.com>, Jason Lee <jason.lee@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Client impact intake: brief discovery call request (Nimbus Health)

Hi Sophie (and Jason),

Quick note — Redwood's Customer Marketing team is putting together a short case study spotlight to share how Nimbus Health used our dedicated inference routing to reduce latency and cost for triage workflows. We'd love a 30-minute discovery call to capture outcomes, stakeholders, and any example metrics you can share.

Proposed agenda (30 minutes):
- 5m intros and context
- 10m goals & outcomes (metrics you track)
- 8m technical touchpoints (architecture, any quantization/throughput notes)
- 5m approvals & publication logistics (quoting, review window)

Proposed windows (PT):
- Wed 5/5 — 10:00–10:30 PT
- Thu 5/6 — 14:00–14:30 PT
- Fri 5/7 — 09:30–10:00 PT

We'd like to record the session for internal write-up and to capture quotes accurately. Recording will not be published without your explicit review and approval; we'll send any quotes for sign-off before release.

I've attached a brief intake template so you can see the info we'll collect (Nimbus_case_study_intake_template.pdf). If you prefer, Marissa (cc'd) will take notes live and we can keep the recording as backup only.

Would either of the Wednesday/Thursday slots work? If not, send a couple alternatives and we'll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Customer Marketing Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Nimbus_case_study_intake_template.pdf (PDF, 210KB)

From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@nimbushealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Client impact intake: brief discovery call request (Nimbus Health)

Hi Mina — thanks for reaching out. Happy to participate and appreciate the transparency on recording/quote approval. Jason (copied on my reply) is the best person to discuss the technical throughput numbers — he should be on the call.

We can do
- Wed 5/5 at 10:00–10:30 PT OR
- Thu 5/6 at 14:00–14:30 PT

Either works for us; Wed is slightly better. Justin from procurement may want to weigh in on the release language, but that can be asynchronous — we just need a short review window before publication.

Also: small ask — could you share the specific metrics you intend to quote (e.g., 95th percentile latency, tokens/sec improvement, cost per inference)? We can pre-populate those for the draft to speed review.

Thanks,
Sophie Turner
Director, Product Ops
Nimbus Health

Great — thanks Sophie. Confirming Wed 5/5 at 10:00–10:30 PT. I've put a tentative calendar hold and will send a confirmed invite in a moment: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abcd-1234

Next steps / prep:
- I've attached a short draft of the discovery questions we'll use (discovery_questions_v1.docx) so you can flag anything to skip.
- Marissa will run the note taking and capture any direct quotes; recording will be used only as a transcript backup unless you request otherwise.
- If there are any internal stakeholders who should be added (legal/procurement), please loop them in to the invite — we can keep them off the recording if preferred.

Permission to record for internal transcription and quote capture? We'll share a draft for your review and sign-off before anything is published.

Thanks again — looking forward.

Best,
Mina
Customer Marketing Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: discovery_questions_v1.docx (DOCX, 35KB)
